ruling.recommended_action: Close the case as no_action: the only off-route segment is the way to the rider-named stop at Clementi Mall and is exempt, so the metered fare incl. $1.15 waiting stands; no account flag (RD-6 condition unmet).
ruling.reasoning:
At 14:17 the rider sent a message naming a specific place and purpose — "Can you stop at Clementi Mall? I need to grab a parcel, 3-4 minutes." — and the driver answered "Sure" one minute before the segment began at 14:21 [F9][F10][F4]. That is a rider-named stop agreed before the segment, so under RD-3(a) the segment driven to reach the named place is not a detour and its extra kilometres are exempt in full [RD-3]. The car did stop at the place the rider named, standing 4 min 0 s at 14:23–14:27, which matches the 3–4 minutes the rider offered [F2][F9].

The trace fixes the required finding: F4 is grounded rider_named_stop and the finding that follows is exempt. The stationary fact F2 sits inside the 14:21–14:31 segment, and the driver's statement — that he drove to Clementi Mall and waited — places the segment at the place the rider named, not somewhere else [F12][F2]. RD-3(a) does not reduce the exemption for the length of the stop or the distance of the named place, so the whole way there, including the stationary stretch, is exempt; it would be wrong to carve the loop into "the stop" and "the way there" [RD-3].

Nothing else excuses or re-charges that segment. No incident was recorded on the replaced optimal stretch during the trip window, so RD-4(a) does not apply, and the two speed-band readings (band 4 on Ayer Rajah Expressway, band 3 on Jurong Town Hall Road) are neither on the replaced stretch nor exempt on their own under RD-4(b) [F13][F14][F15][RD-4]. Because no segment is non-exempt, no RD-2 mileage refund arises [RD-2]. The rider's alternative theory — an "extra ~0.29 km" spread between the billed 1.96 km and the recorded 1.70 km — is conceded by the rider's own advocate as corridor/map-matching noise RD-2 does not refund, and in any event it is not an identified off-route segment under RD-1 [F5][F4][RD-1][RD-2].

On the money: this is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so the fare is not a fixed quote and RD-2's distance formula is the only route to a refund here. There is no applied refund because the sole segment is exempt, so the amount is null. Independently, the bill contains no unpublished add-on: $25.33 = base $3.90 + distance $14.65 + time $4.16 + waiting $1.15 + platform $1.47, discount $0.00, surge 1.0×, so FARE-1 strips nothing [F8][F7][FARE-1]. The $1.15 waiting item is 4.4 metered waiting minutes, which for RydeTAXI is a published metered waiting unit charged as the meter runs, not refundable under RD-3(c) [F6][F2][RD-3].

On RD-6: the driver's profile carries route_disputes_upheld_90d = 2, which would make this a repeated breach once a case is upheld against him, but RD-6 requires that the case be established (RD-2 refund > 0 or a recorded RD-1 breach), and here no segment is non-exempt and no refund arises [F18][RD-6]. The account flag therefore does not attach: the profile fact cannot itself establish the deviation, and it is not used to decide this case.

Safety screen: I read the complaint, both chat messages, the driver's statement and the full record. The messages are a stop request and an acceptance; the complaint is about money only; the statement is a factual account; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12]. The reading is none.

Confidence is 0.82 rather than higher because the "extra ~0.29 km" attributed elsewhere and the unattributed +2.0 km actual-vs-optimal gap are left unresolved under RD-2; they change neither the amount nor any flag, so they do not require escalation [F1][F5][RD-2].

segment_findings.reason: The rider named a specific place before the segment — "Can you stop at Clementi Mall? I need to grab a parcel, 3-4 minutes." at 14:17 [F9] — and the driver accepted with "Sure" [F10], before the segment start (14:21) [F4]. The car stopped there (stationary 4 min 0 s at 14:23–14:27, F2) and the driver's statement confirms he drove to Clementi Mall and waited [F12]. Under RD-3(a) the whole way to the rider-named place is exempt, and the exemption is not reduced by the length of the stop or the distance of the place; RD-5 is not engaged because the rider named the stop, not a specific road, and the record places the segment at the named place rather than elsewhere [RD-3][RD-5].

rejected_claims.reason: The single off-route segment F4 exists as described [F4][RD-1], but it is the way to the place the rider named and agreed in advance [F9][F10], so it is exempt under RD-3 and produces no refundable mileage [RD-3][RD-2].

The rider's claim that the stop exemption cannot cover the whole 1.70 km fails: under RD-3(a) the whole way to the rider-named place is exempt and the segment is not split into "the stop" and "the way there" [F9][F10][F2][F4][RD-3].

The requested $2.40 refund (1.70 km × $1.4100/km = $2.397) presupposes a non-exempt segment [F4][F5]; the segment is exempt under RD-3(a) because the rider named Clementi Mall before it began [F9][F10][RD-3][RD-2].

flag_account under RD-6 requires this case to be established (RD-2 refund > 0 or a recorded RD-1 breach); no segment is non-exempt here, and the profile fact F18 cannot itself establish the deviation [F18][RD-6].

The driver's point that the record shows no rider agreement to any route is irrelevant in his favour: the rider named a stop, not a route, and RD-3(a) — not RD-5 — exempts the way to that named place, so the missing route consent does not put the segment back into the refundable pool [F9][F10][F4][RD-3][RD-5].

"No traffic incident" and the band 3/band 4 readings are used to support the exemption [F13][F14][F15][RD-4], but the exemption rests on the rider-named stop under RD-3, not on any traffic ground [F9][F2][RD-3].

Correct that the bill has no unpublished add-on [F8][F7][FARE-1], but the rider's claim is RD-2 metered mileage, not a FARE-1 item; it nevertheless fails because the segment is exempt under RD-3 [F4][F5][RD-2][RD-3].
